description: Finding carries evaluated_at_unix: u64 for evidence packs. DeviatedFinding derived from it does not carry this field. An auditor examining a DeviatedFinding cannot determine when the deviation was evaluated without correlating back to the now-consumed original Finding. Fix: add evaluated_at_unix to DeviatedFinding and populate in apply_deviations. File: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs lines 462-483.
title: pkix-lint: DeviatedFinding missing evaluated_at_unix field
